generator.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one clean environment background plate for two alternate bounded room-stage crops in a survival strategy game. Generate exactly one new native 3840 x 2160 PNG, 16:9, no upscaling from smaller source. Scene: a deserted low-light hospital surveillance and facilities workroom. One coherent practical room, no split screen or collage. LEFT ZONE x=15%-43%: an old battered steel security duty desk against the back wall, two obsolete chunky CRT surveillance monitors, both switched off with dark reflective glass and no image or display content, one empty worn office chair tucked into the desk; the desktop is bare aside from the monitor bodies. RIGHT ZONE x=60%-85%: a compact bank of grey-green facilities control cabinets, fully closed; modest unlit blank display windows and unlabeled physical knobs, realistic plain industrial panels, no readable markings, no visible schematic. The cabinets must look like hospital building maintenance equipment rather than a sci-fi command center. The center is a calm strip of worn plain wall with conduit above, with empty low-contrast floor in front. Hospital materials: dirty desaturated teal painted lower walls, aged off-white plaster upper walls, cracked concrete/terrazzo floor, chipped metal, dusty vents, modest cable conduits. Dense restrained tactile detail, believable medium-size utility workroom. Cinematic photorealistic survival-game environmental illustration, cold blue-grey and teal-black shadow palette with one dim warm tungsten workroom wall fixture, soft weak cool fluorescent ambient light; readable dark midtones, no hazy blur. Composition: stable eye-level 28 mm wide nearly frontal view, no dutch angle, clear center safe focal area, left desk silhouette and right cabinets each entirely visible with breathing room so left-weighted crop supports H3 security room and right-weighted crop supports H7 logistics control room. Empty center foreground available for independently implemented action UI. No person, NPC, enemy, silhouette, reflection of a person, corpse, gore. No HUD, UI, interface framing, graphic panels, map, labels, letters, numbers, words, readable text, hospital name, logo or watermark. No camera feeds, floor plans, route diagram, active status data, completion indicator or lit control buttons. No visible keycard, keys, papers, tools, batteries, medical supplies, bags, weapon, collectible, reward or loose component. These monitors/cabinets are visual set dressing only, not new gameplay actions or loot. The shared plate is an art reuse candidate and must not imply the canonical H3 and H7 nodes are the same room or directly adjacent. Deliver one independent full-bleed native 3840x2160 PNG.
